description.en: Deep collaboration with authors, helping plan book structure and content to achieve publishing-quality standards
description.zh: 与作者深度协作，帮助规划书籍结构和内容，达到出版级品质

welcome_message.en: I want to write a book but lack writing experience and a framework. I need professional book creation guidance. Please, Book Co-creator, help me plan the book structure and content.
welcome_message.zh: 我想写一本书但缺乏写作经验和框架,需要专业的书籍创作指导,请图书共创专家帮我规划书籍结构和内容。

en: I want to write a book but lack writing experience and a framework. I need professional book creation guidance. Please, Book Co-creator, help me plan the book structure and content.
